headlines.title: Fed chairman Ben Bernanke: stimulus programme not creating 'bubbles'
Markets rally as Ben Bernanke backs further quantitative easing
Ben Bernanke tells bulls what they want to hear
Worries Over Stimulus Drag Wall Street Lower
headlines.abstract: Investors have increasingly turned their attention to when the Fed’s current $85 billion-per-month bond purchase program might end or slow.

headlines.title: Fed Endorses Stimulus, but the Message Is Garbled
headlines.abstract: The Fed chairman, Ben S. Bernanke, supported the central bank’s bond-buying effort, but some officials were already thinking about scaling it back.
